title: Warm Crispy Portuguese Fish Bacalhau à Brás
description: A rich and savory Portuguese dish made with crispy shredded salt cod, onions, potatoes, and red pepper paste, all served in a warm and crispy dutch oven.
instructions: Rinse the dried salt cod under cold water and soak it in water for at least 24 hours, changing the water every 6 hours.
Once the bacalhau is rehydrated, flake it into shredded pieces and set it aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize, about 10-12 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the red pepper paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the shredded bacalhau to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and potato mixture.
Transfer the mixture to the preheated Dutch oven and top with chopped parsley.
Bake the bacalhau in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Serve the warm and crispy bacalhau straight from the Dutch oven.
